headline: Canva Graphic Designer
skills: Graphic design for social media, menus and flyers
Content planning for small business pages
summary: Self-taught Canva designer from Marinduque looking for a remote or local design role. Since graduating from senior high school I have made social media posts, menus and flyers for local shops and resorts and taken the product photos behind them. I work fast and follow each client's colours and style.

experience.title: Freelance Canva Designer
bullets: Create weekly social media posts for five local shops, cafés and a beach resort.
Photograph food and products with a smartphone and simple lighting for their pages.
Plan a monthly posting calendar with each client around paydays and the Moriones season.

education.credential: Senior High School, Arts and Design Track

projects.name: Moriones Festival poster series
projects.description: A set of eight festival posters shared by the municipal tourism page.
